title: H5: publish a note article for EC sellers pointing to the free 注文CSV→送り状CSV converter tool (owned note account, honest, free-setup offer)

Log event signal qualified_reach (note) + done with the note URL. This is content on an OWNED account only. READY DRAFT by founder 2026-10-18: marketing/2026-10/h5/note_01.md (publish as-is or lightly edit; note has no tables so render the before/after as a list — see the draft's HTML comment header for tags + the signal/done events to log).
